Job description:
At Goldiran, with an innovative and AI-First approach, we are looking for an Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer to design and implement the intelligent core of our next-generation products. This role is an exceptional opportunity to build an advanced system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) from the ground up and shape the future of user interaction with data. The responsibilities will involve the design and architecture, development, and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs), directly impacting the quality, accuracy, and efficiency of the final product. Responsibilities 
• Design, implementation, and full deployment of an RAG pipeline using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. 
• Architecture and management of Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Milvus. 
• Development and optimization of embedding generation processes from textual and multimodal data. 
• Integration of systems with Large Language Models (LLMs) via APIs (such as GPT-4o, Claude 3.5) and preparing infrastructure for self-hosted models. 
• Implementation of advanced techniques to improve the Retrieval and Re-ranking of results. 
• Research and implementation of solutions to reduce Hallucination and increase the accuracy and relevance of model responses. 
• Close collaboration with Backend and Data Engineering teams for model integration into the main infrastructure and ensuring quality data flow. 
• Optimization of system performance to reduce Latency and implement Streaming logic. 
• Model evaluation, definition of success metrics, and presentation of analytical reports. 
• Staying up-to-date with the latest scientific achievements in NLP and LLMs and applying them to the product.

Qualifications 
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. 
• Practical and proven experience in designing and implementing RAG systems in a Production environment. 
• Complete mastery of the Python programming language and specialized libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face. 
• Deep experience working with Vector Databases and understanding the concepts of Embeddings and semantic search. 
• Skill in using LLM provider APIs (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). 
• Strong understanding of the Transformer architecture and the fundamental concepts of Large Language Models. 
• Ability to analyze problems, structured thinking, and provide innovative solutions.

Advantageous Qualifications 
• Experience in Fine-tuning open-source language models (such as Llama 3, Mistral). 
• Familiarity with MLOps tools and experience in model deployment and monitoring. 
• Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and related AI/ML services. 
• Participation in open-source projects or scientific papers in the field of AI/NLP.

Company description:
Goldiran Asash is one of the youngest subsidiaries of the Goldiran holding that offers optimal services and solutions on the web and using modern technologies. The Goldiran Asash team is growing rapidly and is taking steps to achieve its goal, which is providing a better life for all people. The working environment at Goldiran Asash is dynamic and energetic, and learning opportunities are provided there.
